+import unittest
+
+import cachetools
+
+
+class SetItemGrowTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_grow_existing_fits_no_eviction(self):
+        for cls in (
+            cachetools.Cache,
+            cachetools.FIFOCache,
+            cachetools.LRUCache,
+            cachetools.RRCache,
+            cachetools.LFUCache,
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__):
+                c = cls(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+                c["a"] = 3
+                c["b"] = 3
+                c["b"] = 7
+                self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"a": 3, "b": 7})
+                self.assertEqual(c.currsize, 10)
+
+    def test_grow_existing_matches_delete_then_insert(self):
+        c = cachetools.LRUCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        c["a"] = 3
+        c["b"] = 3
+        del c["b"]
+        c["b"] = 7
+        self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"a": 3, "b": 7})
+        self.assertEqual(c.currsize, 10)
+
+    def test_grow_existing_still_evicts_when_needed(self):
+        c = cachetools.LRUCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        c["a"] = 3
+        c["b"] = 3
+        c["a"] = 8  # 8 + 3 > 10 -> must evict "b"
+        self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"a": 8})
+        self.assertEqual(c.currsize, 8)
+
+    def test_grow_existing_evicting_self_becomes_insert(self):
+        c = cachetools.LFUCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        c["a"] = 5
+        c["b"] = 5
+        c["a"] = 9  # 9 + 5 > 10; popitem may hit "a" itself
+        self.assertLessEqual(c.currsize, 10)
+        self.assertEqual(c.currsize, sum(dict(c).values()))
+        self.assertIn("a", c)
+        self.assertEqual(c["a"], 9)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+        for cls in (
+            cachetools.Cache,
+            cachetools.FIFOCache,
+            cachetools.LRUCache,
+            cachetools.RRCache,
+            cachetools.LFUCache,
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__):
+                c = cls(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+                c["a"] = 3
+                c["b"] = 3
+                c["b"] = 7
+                self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"a": 3, "b": 7})
+                self.assertEqual(c.currsize, 10)
+
+    def test_grow_existing_matches_delete_insert(self):
+        c = cachetools.LRUCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        c["a"] = 3
+        c["b"] = 3
+        del c["b"]
+        c["b"] = 7
+        self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"a": 3, "b": 7})
+        self.assertEqual(c.currsize, 10)
+
+    def test_grow_existing_needs_eviction(self):
+        c = cachetools.LRUCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        c["a"] = 3
+        c["b"] = 3
+        c["a"] = 5  # 5 + 3 == 8 fits, no eviction
+        self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"a": 5, "b": 3})
+        c["b"] = 6  # 5 + 6 == 11 > 10, evicts LRU entry "a"
+        self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"b": 6})
+        self.assertEqual(c.currsize, 6)
+
+    def test_grow_existing_self_evicted_becomes_insert(self):
+        c = cachetools.FIFOCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        c["a"] = 4

+        # of size 7, which then evicts "b" as well
+        c["a"] = 7
+        self.assertEqual(dict(c), {"a": 7})

+from toolz import partition_all
+
+
+class SizedIter:
+    """Iterable whose ``__len__`` may disagree with the real item count."""
+
+    def __init__(self, items, length):
+        self._items = list(items)
+        self._length = length
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        return iter(self._items)
+
+    def __len__(self):
+        return self._length
+
+
+def test_partition_all_overestimated_len_no_padding():
+    # __len__ says 7 but only 5 items exist; no no_pad may leak out
+    assert list(partition_all(10, SizedIter(range(5), 7))) == [(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)]
+
+
+def test_partition_all_underestimated_len_keeps_items():
+    # __len__ says 3 but 5 items exist; no items may be dropped
+    assert list(partition_all(10, SizedIter(range(5), 3))) == [(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)]
+
+
+def test_partition_all_len_multiple_of_n_with_short_tail():
+    # len % n == 0 while the real tail is short
+    assert list(partition_all(10, SizedIter(range(5), 10))) == [(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)]
+
+
+def test_partition_all_accurate_len_still_works():
+    assert list(partition_all(3, SizedIter(range(5), 5))) == [(0, 1, 2), (3, 4)]
+    assert list(partition_all(3, SizedIter(range(6), 6))) == [(0, 1, 2), (3, 4, 5)]
